findings.obligation: Oracle RED must be semantic; a load error must not be reported as a missing-behaviour RED (infrastructure defect is oracle-owned)
findings.observation: Line 172 try { line 176 } catch { line 177 return expect.fail(`${whatItIs} is missing (${file}). ... Create it as the settings feature describes.`). The catch discards the original error. A module that exists but throws on load (import error, top-level throw, bad export) is reported as missing and told to be created. Current RED is correct (both files are absent), so this does not invalidate the present RED.
findings.remediation: Before the crafter starts, catch only module-not-found (inspect error code or message) and rethrow any other error with its original message; keep the expect.fail only for the not-found branch.
